function constructCompletionWindowReceivingProgram(parameters, schedule) {
  const program = constructCompletionBaselineProgram(
    parameters,
    `inline`,
    schedule === `failure-first` ? `source-failed-peer` : `held-window`
  );
  if (schedule === `failure-first`) {
    const boundary = program.steps.findIndex(
      (step) => step.kind === `baseline-observe` && step.boundary === `source-failed-peer`
    );
    program.steps = program.steps.slice(0, boundary + 1);
    program.sourceAnswerPremises = {};
  } else {
    program.setup.facts.marked = program.setup.facts.marked.filter(
      (id) => id !== program.selectedKeys.pivot
    );
    program.steps = program.steps.map((step) => {
      if (step.kind === `control` && step.control === `begin-replay`)
        return control(`hold-demand-sources`);
      if (step.kind === `semantic` && step.action.type === `source-answer`)
        return semantic({
          ...step.action,
          facts: structuredClone(program.setup.facts)
        });
      return step;
    });
    for (const premise of program.sourceAnswerPremises.answer ?? [])
      if (premise.source === `children`) premise.since = `answer-release`;
  };
  program.windowReceivingSchedule = schedule;
  program.publicationEpochs = authorCompletionBaselinePublicationEpochs(
    program.setup,
    program.steps
  );
  return program;
};
const semantic = (action) => ({
  kind: `semantic`,
  action
});
const control = (value) => ({
  kind: `control`,
  control: value
});
const observe = (boundary) => ({ kind: `baseline-observe`, boundary });
const require = (id, kind) => semantic({ type: `require`, requirement: { id, kind } });
function constructCompletionBaselineProgram(parameters, profile, gate) {
  if (profile === `inline` && (gate === `park-facade` || gate === `facade-rollback`))
    throw new Error(`completion grammar: ${gate} requires a Collection facade`);
  const { prior, answered } = (0,__vite_ssr_import_1__.completionFacts)(parameters, true);
  const root = prior.roots[0];
  const facadeB = prior.roots[1].id;
  const target = gate === `park-root` || profile === `inline` ? `root` : { bucket: root.id };
  const child = root.id * 100 + 99;
  const overlay = target === `root` ? {
    id: `baseline-hold`,
    kind: `root`,
    row: {
      ...root,
      rank: root.rank - parameters.rankScale / 100,
      children: prior.children.filter((row) => row.parent === root.id).map((row) => row.id)
    }
  } : {
    id: `baseline-hold`,
    kind: `facade`,
    bucket: root.id,
    rows: [
      ...prior.children.filter((row) => row.parent === root.id).map((row) => row.id),
      child
    ]
  };
  const errors = {
    source: `baseline-source`,
    tail: `baseline-tail`,
    graph: `baseline-graph`,
    facadeB: `baseline-facade-B`
  };
  const setup = {
    run: `run-1`,
    profile,
    facts: prior,
    window: { offset: 0, limit: 2 },
    ready: gate !== `initial-status-tail`
  };
  const changedFacts = gate === `park-root` || gate === `subscriber-tail` || gate === `cleanup-abandonment` && target === `root` ? { ...prior, roots: answered.roots } : {
    ...prior,
    children: gate === `facade-rollback` ? answered.children : [...prior.children, { id: root.id * 100 + 3, parent: root.id }]
  };
  const steps = [];
  const initialKeys = prior.roots.slice(0, setup.window.limit).map(({ id }) => id);
  const pivot = parameters.keyShift + 3;
  const pivotRank = prior.roots.find(({ id }) => id === pivot).rank;
  const windowKeys = prior.roots.filter(({ id, rank }) => initialKeys.includes(id) || rank === pivotRank).map(({ id }) => id);
  const sourceAnswerPremises = gate === `initial-status-tail` ? {
    answer: [
      {
        source: `roots`,
        requiredKeys: initialKeys,
        permittedKeys: prior.roots.map(({ id }) => id),
        knowledge: `rows`,
        since: `answer-release`
      },
      ...[`marked`, `children`].map((source) => ({
        source,
        requiredKeys: initialKeys,
        permittedKeys: initialKeys,
        knowledge: `complete-domain`,
        since: `answer-release`
      }))
    ]
  } : gate === `held-window` ? {
    answer: [
      {
        source: `marked`,
        requiredKeys: [pivot],
        permittedKeys: windowKeys,
        knowledge: `complete-domain`,
        since: `answer-release`
      },
      {
        source: `roots`,
        requiredKeys: [pivot],
        permittedKeys: prior.roots.map(({ id }) => id),
        knowledge: `rows`,
        since: `fixture-start`
      },
      {
        source: `children`,
        requiredKeys: [pivot],
        permittedKeys: windowKeys,
        knowledge: `complete-domain`,
        since: `fixture-start`
      }
    ]
  } : gate === `source-failed-peer` ? {
    peer: [
      {
        source: `children`,
        requiredKeys: [pivot],
        permittedKeys: [pivot],
        knowledge: `complete-domain`,
        since: `answer-release`
      }
    ]
  } : {};
  const installAll = () => [
    ...profile === `facade` ? prior.roots.map(
      (row) => semantic({
        type: `install`,
        target: { bucket: row.id },
        snapshot: `desired`
      })
    ) : [],
    semantic({ type: `install`, target: `root`, snapshot: `desired` })
  ];
  const park = (name, outputTarget = target, snapshot = `desired`) => [
    require(name, `output`),
    semantic({
      type: `stage-output`,
      requirement: name,
      target: outputTarget,
      snapshot,
      disposition: `retained`
    })
  ];
  switch (gate) {
    case `establish`:
      break;
    case `park-root`:
    case `park-facade`:
    case `cleanup-abandonment`:
      steps.push(
        semantic({ type: `optimistic-overlay`, overlay }),
        control(`bind-output-holds`),
        semantic({ type: `source-write`, facts: changedFacts }),
        ...park(`selected`),
        observe(`held-output`)
      );
      if (gate === `cleanup-abandonment`)
        steps.push(
          semantic({ type: `cleanup` }),
          semantic({ type: `restart`, run: `run-2`, facts: changedFacts }),
          observe(`cleanup-abandoned`),
          control(`establish-replacement`),
          ...installAll(),
          semantic({ type: `mark-ready` }),
          observe(`public-state`)
        );
      else
        steps.push(
          semantic({ type: `settle-optimistic`, overlay: overlay.id }),
          semantic({ type: `apply-output`, requirement: `selected` }),
          observe(`public-state`)
        );
      break;
    case `facade-rollback`:
      steps.push(
        require(`error-tail`, `publication`),
        semantic({ type: `optimistic-overlay`, overlay }),
        control(`bind-output-holds`),
        control(`arm-facade-B-commit-fault`),
        semantic({ type: `source-write`, facts: changedFacts }),
        ...park(`A-forward`, { bucket: root.id }),
        ...park(`A-restore`, { bucket: root.id }, `restore`),
        semantic({
          type: `tail-failure`,
          requirement: `error-tail`,
          error: errors.facadeB,
          affected: []
        }),
        observe(`facade-rollback`),
        semantic({ type: `settle-optimistic`, overlay: overlay.id }),
        semantic({ type: `apply-output`, requirement: `A-forward` }),
        semantic({ type: `apply-output`, requirement: `A-restore` }),
        observe(`public-state`),
        control(`retry-publication`),
        ...installAll(),
        observe(`public-state`)
      );
      break;
    case `held-window`:
    case `source-failed-peer`:
      steps.push(
        require(`answer`, `source`),
        ...gate === `source-failed-peer` ? [require(`peer`, `source`)] : [],
        control(
          gate === `source-failed-peer` ? `hold-demand-sources` : `begin-replay`
        ),
        semantic({
          type: `request-window`,
          operation: `window`,
          options: { limit: 3 },
          requires: gate === `source-failed-peer` ? [`answer`, `peer`] : [`answer`]
        }),
        observe(`held-window`)
      );
      if (gate === `source-failed-peer`)
        steps.push(
          semantic({
            type: `source-failure`,
            requirement: `answer`,
            error: errors.source
          }),
          observe(`source-failed-peer`),
          semantic({
            type: `source-answer`,
            requirement: `peer`,
            // The pivot child load establishes its unchanged children. It
            // supplies no new root ranks or retained first-two child values.
            facts: prior
          }),
          observe(`public-state`)
        );
      else
        steps.push(
          semantic({
            type: `source-answer`,
            requirement: `answer`,
            // Only marked demand is replayed here. Root ranks and retained
            // children keep their prior facts until their own source writes.
            facts: { ...prior, marked: answered.marked }
          }),
          ...installAll(),
          observe(`completed-window`)
        );
      break;
    case `subscriber-tail`:
      steps.push(
        require(`error-tail`, `publication`),
        control(`arm-subscriber-tail`),
        semantic({ type: `source-write`, facts: changedFacts }),
        ...installAll(),
        semantic({
          type: `tail-failure`,
          requirement: `error-tail`,
          error: errors.tail,
          affected: []
        }),
        observe(`installed-tail-exception`)
      );
      break;
    case `initial-status-tail`:
      steps.push(
        require(`answer`, `source`),
        require(`error-tail`, `publication`),
        control(`prepare-held-initial`),
        control(`arm-initial-status-tail`),
        semantic({
          type: `request-initial`,
          operation: `initial`,
          requires: [`answer`]
        }),
        semantic({
          type: `source-answer`,
          requirement: `answer`,
          facts: answered
        }),
        ...installAll(),
        semantic({ type: `mark-ready` }),
        semantic({
          type: `tail-failure`,
          requirement: `error-tail`,
          error: errors.tail,
          affected: []
        }),
        observe(`installed-tail-exception`)
      );
      break;
    case `graph-failure`:
      steps.push(
        require(`peer`, `source`),
        control(`hold-demand-sources`),
        semantic({
          type: `request-window`,
          operation: `window`,
          options: { limit: 3 },
          requires: [`peer`]
        }),
        control(`throw-current-graph`),
        semantic({ type: `graph-failure`, error: errors.graph }),
        observe(`graph-exception`)
      );
      break;
  };
  return {
    gate,
    parameters,
    setup,
    changedFacts,
    target,
    overlay,
    selectedKeys: {
      root: root.id,
      facadeA: root.id,
      facadeB,
      pivot: parameters.keyShift + 3,
      optimisticChild: child
    },
    answerScopes: {
      failure: { source: `marked`, scope: [parameters.keyShift + 3] },
      peer: { source: `children`, scope: [parameters.keyShift + 3] }
    },
    errors,
    steps,
    publicationEpochs: authorCompletionBaselinePublicationEpochs(setup, steps),
    sourceAnswerPremises
  };
};
function authorCompletionBaselinePublicationEpochs(setup, steps) {
  const epochs = setup.ready ? [
    {
      id: `initialization`,
      kind: `initialization`,
      fromStep: -1,
      throughStep: -1
    }
  ] : [];
  let fromStep = 0;
  for (const [index, step] of steps.entries()) {
    if (step.kind !== `baseline-observe`) continue;
    epochs.push({
      id: `${epochs.length}:${step.boundary}`,
      kind: step.boundary === `cleanup-abandoned` ? `cleanup` : `publication`,
      fromStep,
      throughStep: index
    });
    fromStep = index + 1;
  };
  if (fromStep !== steps.length)
    throw new Error(`completion grammar: every publication interval has a cut`);
  return epochs;
};
function modelCompletionBaselinePublicationEpoch(program, epoch) {
  const authored = authorCompletionBaselinePublicationEpochs(
    program.setup,
    program.steps
  ).find((entry) => entry.id === epoch.id);
  if (!authored || authored.kind !== epoch.kind || authored.fromStep !== epoch.fromStep || authored.throughStep !== epoch.throughStep)
    throw new Error(`completion grammar: unknown authored publication interval`);
  const model = (0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.createCompletionModel)(program.setup);
  for (const step of program.steps.slice(0, epoch.throughStep + 1))
    if (step.kind === `semantic`) (0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.stepCompletionModel)(model, step.action);
  return model;
};
const completionBaselineGates = [
  `establish`,
  `park-root`,
  `park-facade`,
  `facade-rollback`,
  `held-window`,
  `source-failed-peer`,
  `subscriber-tail`,
  `initial-status-tail`,
  `graph-failure`,
  `cleanup-abandonment`
];
function completionBaselineProgramFamily(parameters) {
  return [`inline`, `facade`].flatMap(
    (profile) => completionBaselineGates.filter(
      (gate) => profile === `facade` || gate !== `park-facade` && gate !== `facade-rollback`
    ).map(
      (gate) => constructCompletionBaselineProgram(parameters, profile, gate)
    )
  );
};
(0,__vite_ssr_import_0__.declareOracle)({
  model: [modelCompletionBaselinePublicationEpoch],
  grammar: [
    authorCompletionBaselinePublicationEpochs,
    constructCompletionBaselineProgram,
    constructCompletionWindowReceivingProgram,
    completionBaselineProgramFamily
  ]
});
